description: Current Solana slot, block height and block time plus a prioritization-fee summary (min, median, p75, max, suggested) over the recent slots the public RPC reports; optionally scoped to up to five writable accounts. $0.002/call via x402 (Solana or Base) or MPP (Tempo); repeat calls welcome, readings cached 8 s.

accounts.description: Optional: up to 5 comma-separated base58 pubkeys; the fee sample is then limited to transactions that lock these accounts writable.

name: solana_priority_fee
